name: Neon Daily Mahjong
author: Addicting Games
description: Neon Daily Mahjong is 3 mahjong games in one! Tune in every day for a brand new puzzle to play. Every day is a different challenge. This is a daily game with 3 styles of mahjong games you can play: Mahjong Solitaire, Mahjong Connect, and Triple Mahjong. Mahjong Solitaire follows the more traditional form of mahjong. If you just want to play the classic game, this one is for you. If you want mahjong with a little twist, Mahjong Connect is a similar version but requires different rules for matching the tiles. If you want a real challenge, then check out Triple Mahjong which requires matching 3 open tiles in order to beat the game. Or play all 3 to challenge yourself and enter into our high scores list!
